title: French packaging maker Pinard Beauty Pack taps Meiyume for US expansion
summary: French manufacturer Pinard Beauty Pack, which specializes in plastic bottles for the beauty industry, has entered into a distribution partnership with turnkey beauty solutions provider Meiyume. Under the agreement, Meiyume will distribute Pinard Beauty Pack's solutions in the US, expanding its offering to prestige beauty brands in the market.
